papers.title: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
papers.desc: Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis.

papers.title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
papers.desc: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality.

papers.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
papers.desc: Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks.

papers.title: DeepStress: Stress-Testing Deep Search Agents
papers.desc: While search agents demonstrate impressive capabilities in multi-step question answering, their robustness to poor-quality evidence remains under-explored.

papers.title: JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Use Agents
papers.desc: GPT-6 Astra can drive a robot arm directly through a fixed harness, and scores of such robot-use agents on RoboDojo have risen quickly since.

papers.title: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
papers.desc: As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction.

papers.title: Agent-R^2: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis
papers.desc: Large language models have made rapid progress in agentic reasoning and tool use, raising expectations for agents that can take over realistic productivity work from humans.

papers.title: TurtLES: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Turbulent 3D Neural PDE Surrogates
papers.desc: Machine-learning surrogates are increasingly used to accelerate computational fluid dynamics, yet progress is limited by the lack of benchmarks capturing realistic, time-dependent turbulent flows.

papers.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
papers.desc: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate.

papers.title: Structured Confidence Perturbation via Fisher Geometry for Adversarial Training
papers.desc: Adversarial training is often plagued by "pseudo-attacks", perturbations that significantly increase the loss value but fail to truly alter the model's confidence structure.

papers.title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models
papers.desc: Existing adaptive-reasoning methods shorten the explicit reasoning a model writes, or skip it by switching modes; either way the answer is still written out token by token.

papers.title: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.desc: It is common to train Large Language Models (LLMs) for agentic tasks with Reinforcement Learning (RL) from scalar rewards.

papers.title: A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
papers.desc: Recent work shows that multimodal agents increasingly self-improve without recurring human annotation.

papers.title: The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?
papers.desc: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people seek and consume information, including accounts that differ across languages and regions, especially on contested topics.

papers.title: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
papers.desc: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time.
